name: Hwang Jini
credit: Text: Wikisource (CC BY-SA), ko.wikisource.org 청구영언/규수삼인 and 청구영언/초삭대엽, from the 1728 manuscript of Kim Cheontaek, 청구영언 (Digital Hangeul Museum scan); public domain. No authentic portrait exists.
bio: Hwang Jini (黃眞伊, c. 1506 - c. 1560) was a kisaeng, a professional entertainer and poet, of Gaeseong in the Joseon kingdom of Korea. She was famed in her own time for her beauty, her learning and her skill in song and verse, and she became a figure of many later tales.

Only a handful of her sijo, the three-line songs of Joseon Korea, survive, preserved in the eighteenth-century anthologies. This selection takes those printed under her name in Kim Cheontaek's 청구영언 (Cheonggu yeongeon, 1728); they speak of love, longing and parting.

poems.title: 청산리 벽계수야 (Cheongsalli byeokgyesuya)
poems.author: Hwang Jini
poems.note: From the section 閨秀三人 (three gentlewomen), heading 黃眞, of the second mode 二數大葉 in the 1728 anthology. Middle Korean text.
poems.text:
靑山裏 碧溪水ㅣ야 수이 감을 쟈랑 마라
一到 滄海ᄒᆞ면 도라오기 어려오니
明月이 滿空山ᄒᆞ니 수여 간들 엇더리

poems.title: 동지ㅅ달 기나긴 밤을 (Dongjitdal ginagin bameul)
poems.author: Hwang Jini
poems.note: From the section 閨秀三人 (three gentlewomen), heading 黃眞, of the second mode 二數大葉 in the 1728 anthology. Middle Korean text.
poems.text:
冬至ㅅᄃᆞᆯ 기나긴 밤을 한허리를 버혀 내여
春風 니불 아레 서리서리 너헛다가
어론 님 오신 날 밤이여든 구뷔구뷔 펴리라

poems.title: 내 언제 무신하여 (Nae eonje musinhayeo)
poems.author: Hwang Jini
poems.note: From the section 閨秀三人 (three gentlewomen), heading 黃眞, of the second mode 二數大葉 in the 1728 anthology. Middle Korean text.
poems.text:
내 언제 無信ᄒᆞ여 님을 언제 소겻관ᄃᆡ
月沈 三更에 온 ᄠᅳᆺ이 젼혀 업ᄂᆡ
秋風에 지ᄂᆞᆫ 닙 소릐야 낸들 어이 ᄒᆞ리오

poems.title: 어져 내 일이야 (Eojyeo nae iriya)
poems.author: Hwang Jini
poems.note: From the first mode 初數大葉 of the 1728 anthology, where it is the sixth song (六). Middle Korean text.
poems.text:
어져 내 일이야 그릴 줄을 모로ᄃᆞ냐
이시라 ᄒᆞ더면 가랴마ᄂᆞᆫ 제 구ᄐᆡ야
보내고 그리ᄂᆞᆫ 情은 나도 몰라 ᄒᆞ노라
